dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Presence of multiple irregular 'O' and 'C' shaped structures along the mid-lateral flank, exhibiting high-contrast cream-colored perimeters that transition with a soft gradient into darker brown-grey interior centers.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: Moderate concentration of solid, high-intensity white-to-light-grey pixel clusters lacking internal gradients, primarily clustered in the mid-to-lower lateral regions.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: Centroids of the three most prominent 'O' rings on the central flank form a scalene triangle, with the most posterior point positioned lower on the lateral plane than the two anterior points.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Localized region of high-intensity reddish-pink coloration on the distal margin of the left hind flipper, contrasting with adjacent fur tones and suggesting a possible surface lesion or abrasion.
other_distinctive_markers: Broad, interconnected light-colored pelage patches forming an extensive map-like mosaic pattern across the lower two-thirds of the visible lateral surface.
